mariam: Heads up — after upgrading to py-sdk v1.5.0 our sampleapp rerank pipeline started failing intermittently. Embedding lengths mismatch across batch members (one of the vectors is 1535 instead of 1536). Anyone seen this?

mariam: Quick repro payload we send to /embeddings (using SDK batching helper):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood/embed-small",
  "input": ["doc A", "doc B"]
}
```

mariam: Truncated response (from SDK client):
```json
{
  "data": [
    {"embedding": [0.12, 0.34, ..., 0.98]},
    {"embedding": [0.12, 0.34, ..., 0.45]  /* length 1535 */}
  ]
}
```

mariam: Our retriever code asserts all vectors are same length so this causes a hard crash. Not sure if this is padding, streaming cutoff, or SDK reshape bug.

alex: can you paste exact len() for each vector and the sdk helper config?

mariam: len(vec0)=1536, len(vec1)=1535

mariam: Using BatchHelper(batch_size=8, pad_to_multiple=None, retry_on_429=True) from devex sampleapp.

kevin: `pad_to_multiple=None` changed default in 1.5.0 — previously it auto-padded to 64. If the helper tries to pack w/o padding it might be doing an internal copy and an off-by-one when trimming.

rui: also check if auth retry doubles the request and the server streams get interleaved. Can you run a raw curl vs SDK to rule out server?

mariam: good idea. curl to hosted API (same payload):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood/embed-small","input":["doc A","doc B"]}' | jq '.data[].embedding | length'
```

mariam: curl output:
```
1536
1536
```

mariam: so server returns correct dims — points at SDK batching helper or local reshape.

alex: thanks — that isolates it. can you paste the minimal snippet that calls the helper?

mariam: snippet:```python
from redwood import BatchHelper, Client
client = Client()
helper = BatchHelper(client.embed, batch_size=8, pad_to_multiple=None)
for out in helper.map(["doc A","doc B"]):
    # downstream expects lists of floats
    print(len(out["embedding"]))
```

kevin: i suspect helper.map yields a flattened buffer and a final reshape step uses the wrong stride when pad_to_multiple is None. i'll try to repro locally.

alex: if you can, add `pad_to_multiple=64` as a workaround. If that works, we'll patch default behavior and add a unit test on array lengths.

mariam: setting pad_to_multiple=64 made the SDK return 1536/1536 consistently. Workaround confirmed. :relieved:

devex-bot: deploy notice — py-sdk v1.5.1 candidate build pushed for internal QA (sha: d4f8b2) :rocket:

alex: I'll open an SDK issue with repro + stack trace and link to this thread (will reference sampleapp). Assigning to @kevin for patch.

kevin: got it — i'll add a fix for the reshape logic + add end-to-end test against hosted endpoint to ensure len(vec) matches jq output.

mariam: thanks all — putting a note in the onboarding doc to avoid pad_to_multiple=None until patch lands.

rui: also adding a short troubleshooting blurb to devex FAQ: "If embeddings lengths differ locally vs curl, try disabling SDK batching or set pad_to_multiple"

mariam: will follow up with the minimal failing repro file and stack dump. Thanks!
